description: This is a Java source file implementing the AccountingDropdownReadPlatformService interface. It provides methods to retrieve various accounting options and account mappings, specifically for GL account types, usage, journal entry types, and different account category options. The class is annotated as a Spring Service and uses dependencies to interact with the account read platform service.

classes.name: AccountingDropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AccountingDropdownReadPlatformService for retrieving accounting dropdown options and account mappings.

methods.name: retrieveGLAccountTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for GL account types using AccountingEnumerations.

methods.name: retrieveGLAccountUsageOptions
methods.description: Returns options for GL account usage types.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntryTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for journal entry types.

methods.name: retrieveAccountingRuleTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for accounting rule types.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptionsForLoanProducts
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping options specifically for loan products.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptionsForSavingsProducts
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping options specifically for savings products.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptionsForCharges
methods.description: Retrieves account options for charges, including income and liability accounts.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptions
methods.description: General method to retrieve account options based on included account types.
